watchdog_risk.meaning: A terminal PC24 watchdog can precede healthy cold-refill completion; do not classify that terminal as proved deadlock without causal state/producer evidence. No watchdog or runtime changed.
watchdog_risk.initialization: After priming, 64 ticks and token start, lastpc initialized ~0 and last_move=cyc. First loop sample updates last_move; every subsequent change by ANY rank resets it.
watchdog_risk.trigger: cyc-last_move > WD; WD=RT_WATCHDOG=100000; triggers on the100001st cycle since latest ANY-rank PC change, not row/sector progress.
watchdog_risk.last_move_observation: CYC12200 allPC22; CYC12400 allPC24. If unchanged thereafter, last_move is in[12201,12400], so trigger in[112202,112401]. Precise intra-checkpoint transition is not exported.
watchdog_risk.terminal_classification: Prints WATCHDOG with core state/idles/waited/CDMA words, breaks loop, dumps all4 VM arrays, prints TIMEOUT, returns1 if any rank notDONE. Does NOT set a DUT fault bit or prove circular wait; timeout must remain failed/incomplete, not exact/PASS.

actual_admission_dependency_audit.result: No circular dependency found in inspected PC24 source path; actual state/progress unobserved, not a deadlock-free RTL proof.
edges: PC21 matching producer/drain can issue via win_su_match&&win_issue_ready, win_admit exception; unrelated operations require win_idle.
Core u_blocks drains16blocks; EMPTY reached on final blk_v&&blk_ready. Source blk_ready=!schedule_busy&&prefetch_stateIDLE; before descriptor starts source schedule is idle.
Core PC24 S_DEC waits win_idle. Descriptor kvd_v emitted only for S_DEC attention decode while win_idle; no source prefetch is announced until packed core row handoff drained.
Accepted descriptor starts schedule without waiting for core me_go or SU idle; prefetch_ready may wait remaining final block writes, but writer grant/wr_done has no me_go dependency.
WINDOW one-credit FR issues m_v unconditionally while address legal; FR_DONE awaits routed response. req_rdy derives queue room, rsp_rdy for WINDOW constant1, not kv_ok or stream_go.
Final sector response sets stage_valid/tag/user and IDLE; pf_ok then permits schedule WAIT->SEND or ISSUE.
staged_v=issue_v&&!staged_sent is independent of stream_go and merge_start_ready; raises descriptor STAGE->READY and kv_ok.

Core waits SU idle,unit_ready,kv_ok and !kvd_v,win_idle. Once true me_go emitted then S_GO advances PC25; stream_go/merge starts only afterward. This ordering breaks kv_ok/attention-issue circularity.
actual_admission_dependency_audit.other_blockers: Fault, invalid row/user/tag/address, unserved transport response, unexpected competing queues, SU nonretirement or engine notready remain possible; PC-only samples cannot distinguish them.

instrumentation_gap.periodic: PC only; no actual m_v/m_rdy/rsp_v/rsp_rdy count, rows_refilled, sectors_read, prefetch_state, desc_state, kv_ok or win_idle snapshot.
instrumentation_gap.terminal: dbg_state carries core st/d_unit/idles/coll_busy/waited/CDMA status; dbg_words is CDMA, not WINDOW reads. This can localize admission vs SU but cannot prove actual2176request progress.
